definitions: To be in a state of anxious anticipation or suspense.
To be very nervous or excited about something that is going to happen.
examples: I've been on pins and needles all week waiting for the results.
She was on pins and needles before her job interview.
We were all on pins and needles during the final minutes of the game.
lemma: to be on pins and needles
source: to be on pins and needles
